levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن أبي حمزة

notes: «أبي» and «أخي» are bare relations (rule 7); «علي بن الحسين» and «محمد بن الحسن» are co-transmitters in one level, joined by «جميعا»
«صندل [صفوان]»: the bracket is an editor's alternative, not a name: left out (rule 1); only «صندل» is read
«قال كنت جالسا» is Dawud's first-person account: the Imam in the scene (Abu Abd Allah speaks and acts) is not a link; held for ruling (rule 11)
The second isnad comes after the saying: «وَحَدَّثَنِي ... بِإِسْنَادِهِ مِثْلَهُ» is another group (rule 4); «بإسناده» is a back_reference to the first route
